notes: Modified-Sarmanov multivariate COM-Poisson construction is portable for correlated low-count joint score modeling; heavy GIMH/noisy-exchange Bayesian machinery not adopted.
First stake-level study of live-betting reaction to news; 1 Hz bookmaker stake data proprietary, so adapt the state-space design to odds-derived proxies rather than replicating stakes.

Coursework-quality textbook Poisson GLM: post-event leakage (shots/corners/halftime goals), no held-out validation, selection bias; duplicates stronger Poisson/Dixon-Coles material already inventoried.

Adapt the nested conditional mechanism (simulate stronger team's score first, condition weaker team's on it) as an NFL garbage-time/prevent-defense dependence primitive; reject EURO-specific fits and full ZIGP machinery.
Adapt inverse RL from winning teams' action sequences to NFL situational decisions; reject cricket-specific DLS replacement/simulator; gate requires synthetic reward-recovery validation.
Survey with no novel results; Koopman/DMD lane already falsified in MOVE-37 (p=0.89, AR(1) wins); RL discussion less actionable than paper 0243.

Adapt fixed-volume bucketing, taker/maker flow decomposition, deeper-book liquidity metrics, and scarce-liquidity detection to Kalshi/Polymarket NFL order books; central regressions are descriptive, not trading signals.

Narrow ADAPT: only the epsilon-worst-drop sensitivity diagnostic (multilinear alpha_ij decomposition) for futures/bracket risk; draw-fixing NP-completeness framework irrelevant (NFL bracket is fixed).

Adapt the FPM bootstrap prediction architecture (correlated performance-vector resampling -> distribution over win probability + hypothesis-test pick rule) and factor-magnitude priors; do not adopt the stale 2009-2015 model as-is.

Baseball paper; mixture-of-Weibulls beats only the single-Weibull strawman, not the deployed 1.83-exponent formula (0.06 games, n.s.); 7-parameter team fits need 162-game seasons, untransferable to 17-game NFL.
